# Product page: Trail Runner 2

A product page for our new trail running shoe, Trail Runner 2, on the Stride online store. The store is already a React app with a homepage that links to `/products/trail-runner-2`; build the product page at that address, using mock data, and don't add any packages to the app beyond React and its build tool. For the look, you can take inspiration from this design:

![Trail Runner 2 product page](design.jpg)

- **Store:** the shopper sees the store name and how many items are in their cart.
- **Path:** the shopper sees where the shoe sits in the store, such as Shop, Trail, Trail Runner 2, and can go back to any earlier step.
- **Photos:** the shopper sees one photo of the shoe at a time and can move to the next or previous one, going back to the first after the last.
- **Price:** the shopper sees the price and can point at a small "i" next to it to learn that it includes taxes.
- **Color:** the shopper can choose blue, black or grey; only the chosen color shows until they change it, each with a round swatch.
- **Size:** the shopper picks one size from a list that only opens when they want to change it; only the chosen size shows, and sold-out sizes can't be picked.
- **Size guide:** the shopper can open a size chart over the page from next to the size, enter their foot length and choose US or EU to get their size, and must close it to continue.
- **Quantity:** the shopper can choose how many pairs to buy, typing the number or changing it by one.
- **Add to cart:** the shopper adds the shoe to the cart and sees a confirmation; without a size they are asked to pick one.
- **Wishlist:** the shopper can save or unsave the shoe with a heart.
- **More information:** details, reviews and shipping sit side by side below everything, with one section shown at a time.
- **Questions:** a few common questions about the shoe, each with its answer hidden until the shopper opens it.
- **Bottom of the page:** the shopper finds customer help, company and social media links.
----

content.text: Now a browser script that loads the page, checks for console errors, and exercises every requirement, saving screenshots along the way.

input.command:
cd /tmp/e2e && cat > check.mjs <<'EOF'
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core'
const EXE = '/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome'
const URL = 'http://localhost:4173/products/trail-runner-2'
const browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: EXE, args: ['--no-sandbox'] })
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } })
const errors = []
page.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error' || m.type() === 'warning') errors.push(m.text()) })
page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push('PAGEERROR ' + e.message))
const ok = (c, msg) => { console.log((c ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') + msg); if (!c) process.exitCode = 1 }

await page.goto(URL, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
ok(await page.locator('h1', { hasText: 'Trail Runner 2' }).isVisible(), 'title renders')
ok((await page.locator('.store-logo').textContent()) === 'Stride', 'store name shown')
ok((await page.locator('.store-cart__count').textContent()) === '0', 'cart count starts at 0')
ok((await page.locator('.breadcrumb').innerText()).replace(/\s+/g,' ').includes('Shop › Trail › Trail Runner 2'), 'breadcrumb path')
ok(await page.locator('.shoe-art').first().isVisible(), 'photo renders')
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/e2e/1-top.png' })

// Gallery wrap-around
const counter = page.locator('.gallery__counter')
ok((await counter.textContent()).trim() === '1 / 4', 'gallery starts at 1/4')
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next photo' }).click()
ok((await counter.textContent()).trim() === '4 / 4', 'gallery reaches last photo')
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next photo' }).click()
ok((await counter.textContent()).trim() === '1 / 4', 'gallery wraps to first after last')
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous photo' }).click()
ok((await counter.textContent()).trim() === '4 / 4', 'previous from first goes to last')

// Price tooltip
const tip = page.locator('.price__tip')
ok(!(await tip.isVisible()), 'tooltip hidden initially')
await page.locator('.price__info-btn').hover()
ok(await tip.isVisible(), 'tooltip shows on hover of i')
ok((await tip.textContent()).includes('Includes taxes'), 'tooltip says includes taxes')
await page.mouse.move(0, 0)

// Color
ok((await page.locator('.field__value').first().textContent()) === 'Blue', 'default color Blue')
await page.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Black' }).check({ force: true })
ok((await page.locator('.field__value').first().textContent()) === 'Black', 'color changes to Black')
ok((await page.locator('.swatch__dot').count()) === 3, 'three round swatches')
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/e2e/2-black.png' })

// Size list closed until opened
ok((await page.locator('#size-options').count()) === 0, 'size list closed initially')
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Select size' }).click()
ok((await page.locator('#size-options').count()) === 1, 'size list opens on demand')
const soldBtn = page.locator('.size-opt', { hasText: 'US 7.5' })
ok(await soldBtn.isDisabled(), 'sold-out size cannot be picked')
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/e2e/3-sizes.png' })
await page.locator('.size-opt', { hasText: 'US 9' }).first().click()
ok((await page.locator('#size-options').count()) === 0, 'size list closes after pick')
ok((await page.locator('.size-picker__btn').textContent()).includes('US 9'), 'chosen size shown')

// Quantity
const qin = page.locator('.qty__input')
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Increase quantity' }).click()
ok((await qin.inputValue()) === '2', 'quantity + button')
await qin.fill('3'); await qin.blur()
ok((await qin.inputValue()) === '3', 'quantity typed')
await qin.fill('99'); await qin.blur()
ok((await qin.inputValue()) === '10', 'quantity clamped to 10')
await qin.fill('1'); await qin.blur()

// Wishlist
const wish = page.locator('.wish-btn')
await wish.click()
ok((await wish.getAttribute('aria-pressed')) === 'true', 'wishlist on')
await wish.click()
ok((await wish.getAttribute('aria-pressed')) === 'false', 'wishlist off')

// Add to cart with size chosen
await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Add to cart/ }).click()
ok((await page.locator('.store-cart__count').textContent()) === '1', 'cart count increments')
ok((await page.locator('.added').textContent()).includes('Added 1 × Trail Runner 2 (Black, US 9)'), 'confirmation shown')
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/e2e/4-added.png', fullPage: true })

// Size guide flow
await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
ok((await page.locator('.size-picker__btn').textContent()).includes('Select size'), 'reload resets size')
await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Add to cart/ }).click()
ok(await page.locator('.field__error').first().isVisible(), 'no size: asked to pick one')
ok((await page.locator('.store-cart__count').textContent()) === '0', 'no size: nothing added')
ok(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.classList.contains('size-picker__btn')), 'focus moved to size')

await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Size guide' }).click()
const dlg = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Size guide' })
ok(await dlg.isVisible(), 'size guide opens over page')
await dlg.getByLabel('Foot length (cm)').fill('26.2')
await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Get my size' }).click()
ok((await dlg.locator('.size-result').textContent()).includes('US 9'), 'guide: 26.2cm -> US 9')
await dlg.getByRole('radio', { name: 'EU' }).check()
await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Get my size' }).click()
ok((await dlg.locator('.size-result').textContent()).includes('EU 42.5'), 'guide: EU output 42.5')
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/e2e/5-guide.png' })
await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Use US 9' }).click()
ok((await page.getByRole('dialog').count()) === 0, 'guide closes after using size')
ok((await page.locator('.size-picker__btn').textContent()).includes('US 9'), 'guide size applied')
ok(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.textContent.includes('Size guide')), 'focus returns to size guide link')

// Escape closes guide
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Size guide' }).click()
await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
ok((await page.getByRole('dialog').count()) === 0, 'Escape closes guide')

// Tabs
ok(await page.locator('#panel-details').isVisible(), 'details shown by default')
ok(!(await page.locator('#panel-reviews').isVisible()), 'reviews hidden by default')
await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Reviews' }).click()
ok(await page.locator('#panel-reviews').isVisible() && !(await page.locator('#panel-details').isVisible()), 'only one tab panel visible')
await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Shipping & Returns' }).click()
ok(await page.locator('#panel-shipping').isVisible(), 'shipping tab works')

// FAQ
const faqs = page.locator('.faq__item')
ok((await faqs.count()) === 4, 'four FAQs')
ok(!(await faqs.first().evaluate(d => d.open)), 'answer hidden until opened')
await faqs.first().locator('summary').click()
ok(await faqs.first().evaluate(d => d.open), 'answer shows on open')

// Footer
ok(await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Customer help' }).isVisible(), 'customer help links')
ok(await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Company' }).isVisible(), 'company links')
ok(await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Social media' }).isVisible(), 'social links')
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/e2e/6-full.png', fullPage: true })

// Mobile
const m = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } })
await m.goto(URL, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await m.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/e2e/7-mobile.png', fullPage: true })
ok((await m.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth)) <= 390, 'no horizontal overflow on mobile')

// Breadcrumb link back
await page.locator('.breadcrumb a', { hasText: 'Shop' }).click().catch(()=>{})
console.log('console/page errors:', errors.length ? errors : 'none')
await browser.close()
EOF

content.text:
The Trail Runner 2 product page is built at `/products/trail-runner-2`. A clean `npm ci`, `npm run build` and `npm start` all succeed with no errors, and the page renders in headless Chromium with no console errors.

I drove the page in a browser with a scripted check of 49 assertions, and all pass. They cover the gallery wrap-around, the price tooltip, colour and size selection, sold-out sizes, the quantity limits, the wishlist toggle, add-to-cart with and without a size, the size guide, the tabs, the FAQ and the footer. The page also has no horizontal overflow at 390px wide.

What changed:
- **`src/main.jsx`**: added the route for the product page.
- **`index.html`**: added an empty inline favicon so the browser's automatic `/favicon.ico` request doesn't 404.
- **`src/pages/ProductPage.jsx`** plus components in `src/components/`, mock data in `src/data/trailRunner2.js`, and styles in `src/styles/styles.css`.

No packages were added. Nothing is committed; the changes are in the working tree.

Things you should know:
- **Photos are generated SVG art**, not real product photography. Each one is tinted to the selected colour. Swap in real images when you have them.
- **Breadcrumb links**: "Shop" goes to `/`, which exists. "Trail" goes to `/shop/trail`, which doesn't exist yet, so it will show "Page not found."
- **Footer and social links** all point to `#` as placeholders.
- **Cart and wishlist** are local page state only. The cart count resets on reload and nothing is sent anywhere.
- **Size guide** takes foot length in cm and maps it to the nearest size from a mock chart.
